title: Im developing a 2D Pixel MMORPG where i add all the features i ever wanted to have while playing mmos in past years!
author: GamesRealmTV

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body:
Yea, I want to do the same with space games but space games are definitely way more involved than this is.

I'm glad we live in an era where doing this is accessible.

comments.author: Franki3B_
comments.body: Looks great. Did you create the assets? I’ve never had good luck with AI creating pixel art.

replies.author: GamesRealmTV
replies.body: When i started the project i started it with using these assets [https://mixelslime.itch.io/free-top-down-rpg-32x32-tile-set?download](https://mixelslime.itch.io/free-top-down-rpg-32x32-tile-set?download) but now im slowly replacing them! I use [pixellab.ai](http://pixellab.ai) and is doing a pretty decent job!

comments.author: GlobalCurry
comments.body: Is this inspired by Aspereta/Illutia by any chance?

replies.author: GamesRealmTV
replies.body: No, i never heared about these games but i played Curse of Aros in the past and i loved it!
